flash_reference.active_count_definition: Unique non-lookup parameters used in bulk phase; excludes giant lookup tables and input embedding row lookup; prefill excludes O(window) decoder replay and one-position output head. Those costs are still explicitly executed.

synthetic_pro.active_count_definition: Unique non-lookup parameters used in bulk phase; excludes giant lookup tables and input embedding row lookup; prefill excludes O(window) decoder replay and one-position output head. Those costs are still explicitly executed.

model.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Pro-10T-synthetic
assumptions: Synthetic 64-layer,7168-hidden extrapolation; no released/trained Pro-10T checkpoint or quality equivalence is asserted.
Encoder32 layers/64 heads; decoder32 layers/128 heads. Decoder-only attention widening reconciles the user phase-active anchors without an artificial latency multiplier.
KV/index/Engram source positions are rounded relative-depth mappings from Flash40 to64; sharing quality has not been evaluated.
Exact aggregate ngram table size3439.8B is split across two tables. Row counts are a storage/addressing model, not reconstructed prime hash sizes of a trained checkpoint.
Text backbone only, excluding vision and projector. Three-layer DSpark is accounted separately; its experts128/top3 and five-position draft block follow the Flash reference.

Main controlled experiment uses FP8 matrix storage/compute/activation/communication/KV for comparison with Kimi; FP32 mHC/scalar state remains explicit. Native FP4 storage requires separate conversion assumptions.
o_groups=8 is retained: group-parallel TP>8 is incompatible and must be reported rather than silently reshaped.

experiment.rank_mapping: replica contiguous, then EP lane, then TP; experts interleaved by expert_id % EP
experiment.prefill_rule: Preserve separate global bs1 and bs8 TTFT; decode bs sweep does not silently redefine TTFT.
experiment.routing: deterministic cyclic distinct top-k sets, no assumed learned correlation
experiment.timing: preloaded weights; no queue/tokenization/client delivery; all components serialized by barriers
experiment.precision: FP8 comparison, FP32 router/mHC/scalar operations, per32 KV/Engram scales; no FP4 speed assumption
